title: Rava bar Itai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shevuot 36b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.36b.19), Rav Acha bar Huna, Rav Shmuel son of Rabbah bar bar Chana and Rav Yitzchak son of Rav Yehudah were studying Shevuot in Rabbah’s school; Rav Kahana met them and asked them. In the continuation at [Shevuot 37a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.37a.1-4), Rava bar Itai said to them: “Who is the Tanna who [holds that] deliberate…,” etc.
In [Bava Metzia 14a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.14a.6) he said to Rav Idi bar Avin: “Did Shmuel say so?”
In [Keritot 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.24a.13), Rabbah bar Itai speaks in the name of Resh Lakish.[^1]

notes.text: Shevuot and Bava Metzia give Rava, but Keritot gives Rabbah. Compare [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3191&lang=en) for the Rabbah form and its cross-reference.
